senses.gloss: m.(b. h. מרפש; רָפס)that which is trodden.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 47">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLVII</cite> <he>שלא ישתה … כי אם מִרְפַּס רגלם</he> that no Israelite shall drink the wine of idolaters, but only wine trodden with their own feet (allud. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 34:19">Ez. XXXIV, 19</cite>).
